title: Knowledge-Aware Iterative Retrieval for Multi-Agent Systems

defines.name: Knowledge-Aware Iterative Retrieval for Multi-Agent Systems
defines.definition: A multi-agent iterative retrieval framework that refines queries and filters evidence using dynamically updated internal knowledge to improve multi-step QA.

problem: Conventional RAG and iterative retrieval methods struggle with multi-step reasoning, effective evidence filtering, and avoiding bias-reinforcement loops in open-domain QA.
